rows.line: そう、俺は何してんだろうと思った。
rows.en2: What am I doing with my life?

rows.line: いや、向こうからしたらすごいよね。
rows.en2: From their side, though...

rows.line: 男2人で遊園地って、なかなか見ないよね。
rows.en1: You don't see that every day.
rows.en2: That's a rare sight.

rows.line: どうなのかなと思いつつも。
rows.en2: I wasn't sure, but...

rows.line: そしたらこの低たらだよ。終わったわ、もう。
rows.en2: It's over.

rows.line: もう本当地獄のような話。
rows.en2: Absolute nightmare.

rows.line: おめえの目の前で別れたわけじゃねえから。
rows.en1: It's not like I broke up right in front of you.
rows.en2: I didn't exactly do it in front of you.

rows.ja: それは〜ことじゃねえだろ
rows.line: それは泣くことじゃねえだろ。それは怒ることだからな。
rows.en1: You don't cry over that, you get mad.
rows.en2: That's a get-mad thing, not a cry thing.

rows.line: デートなんか記憶に残っているデートはありますか。
rows.en1: Any dates that really stuck with you?
rows.en2: Any date you still remember?

rows.ja: かなり思い返したんですけど
rows.line: いやいや、かなり思い返したんですけど。
rows.en2: I really thought about it, and...

rows.line: なんかすげえ嬉しそうに。
rows.en2: He was so proud of it.

rows.line: 今思えば別に高校生だったらマックでもいいな。
rows.en2: Now that I think about it...

rows.ja: せめて〜にしときゃよかった
rows.line: せめてファミレスぐらいにしときゃよかったかな。
rows.en1: I should've at least gone somewhere a little nicer.
rows.en2: Could've at least done a family restaurant.

rows.line: いくらなんでもちょっと行きやすすぎるぞ。
rows.en1: Come on, that's way too casual.
rows.en2: That's pushing it, even for a teenager.

rows.line: まぁそういう、そんなもんでしょっていうのはあるよね。
rows.en2: It is what it is.

rows.line: やっぱ背伸びしたかったりするじゃん、高校生。
rows.en1: You want to act older than you are.
rows.en2: You try to look more grown-up.

rows.line: 確信も得られず、なんかね踏み込めなかったんだよね。
rows.en2: I just couldn't go for it.

rows.line: 告白するんだったら少しは勝算感じたい。
rows.en1: You want to know you've got a shot.
rows.en2: You want at least decent odds.

rows.line: 勝算ある時に行きたいじゃない。分かるわ。
rows.en2: Totally get that.

rows.line: だからもうやきもきするわけよ。
rows.en2: You're going crazy waiting.

rows.line: あれ、たまんないよね。
rows.en2: That kills me.

rows.line: 好きな人だったら真っ先に返すんじゃねえの。
rows.en1: If she liked me, she'd text back right away.
rows.en2: You'd reply first thing if you liked someone.

rows.line: その人はペさんに止められたのよ。やめとけと。
rows.en2: Stay away from that one.

rows.ja: そんな風には見えない
rows.line: そんな風には見えないけどねみたいな感じで。
rows.en2: You'd never guess.

rows.line: いや、懐かしい懐かしいわ。
rows.en2: Oh, the memories.

rows.ja: パッて思い浮かぶのが
rows.line: デートつってパッて思い浮かぶのがね。
rows.en1: The first thing that comes to mind is...
rows.en2: What pops into my head is...

rows.line: リーサルウェポンに出るんだつって、楽しいに違いないつって。
rows.en1: This is going to be awesome.
rows.en2: No way this isn't fun.

rows.line: その時俺はもう浮かれて楽しいから。
rows.en2: I was way too hyped.

rows.line: 映画を見に行くけど、俺1人で盛り上がっちゃって。
rows.en1: I got all excited by myself.
rows.en2: I was the only one hyped.

rows.ja: そっちでなんとかしてもらわないと
rows.line: それはそっちでなんとかしてもらわないと。
rows.en2: You've got to figure that out yourself.

rows.line: それはデートじゃねえもん。
rows.en2: You can't call that a date.

rows.line: リーサルウェポン4から見るのはお勧めしないかもしれない。
rows.en2: Don't do what I did.

rows.line: 待つ選択肢はなかったかな。
rows.en2: It never even crossed my mind to wait.

rows.line: なんなら別に大丈夫だろうみたいな。
rows.en1: If anything, I figured it'd be fine.
rows.en2: Honestly, I thought it was no big deal.

rows.line: そういうのやっぱ事前に仕入れないと。
rows.en1: You've got to do your homework.
rows.en2: You have to find that stuff out first.
